name: Serial
notes: Project accepts an ASCII letter/digit/hyphen serial, 6–20 characters.

name: Model code
notes: Only 3599 / 0x0E0F is accepted by the current tools.

name: Rated AC power
notes: Raw 100 is the required 10 kW identity check.

name: Output connection type
notes: 0 single phase; 1 three-phase four-wire; 2 three-phase three-wire. Affects voltage interpretation.

name: AC voltages A/B/C
notes: Phase/line meaning depends on output type 5002; project displays phase labels.

name: Legacy grid frequency
notes: Project can infer 0.01 Hz from the raw range; 5242 is preferred.

name: Operating-state word
notes: Not the holding Start/Stop word. See state table.

name: Power-flow flags
notes: Not decoded into flow arrows; do not infer signs from this reference.

name: Reported load
notes: Can describe a shared connection; do not sum duplicate reports.

name: Reported grid exchange
notes: Project interprets positive as export; opposite to documented meter-phase signs.

name: Meter phase 1 active power
notes: Valid forwarded meter required; P11 says positive import and negative export. CLI values retains the reported sign.

name: Meter phase 2 active power
notes: Valid forwarded meter required; P11 says positive import and negative export. CLI values retains the reported sign.

name: Meter phase 3 active power
notes: Valid forwarded meter required; P11 says positive import and negative export. CLI values retains the reported sign.

name: Legacy battery current
notes: SHRT nominal legacy encoding; signedness differs in other model families. Project uses 5631 instead.

name: Legacy battery power
notes: Use signed 5214–5215 instead.

name: Battery current
notes: Preferred signed current. Direction labels are not inferred by the CLI values.

name: Battery power
notes: Signed measurement; CLI values does not infer a universal direction label.

name: Permitted charge current
notes: BMS limit, not actual current and not proof charging is active.

name: Battery capacity
notes: Reported capacity, not directly measured remaining usable energy.

name: Total backup power
notes: P11 signed; P2 used U32. Decoder follows signed encoding; check firmware compatibility.

name: Inverter alarms
notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

name: Grid faults
notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

name: BDC faults
notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

name: Permanent BDC faults
notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

name: BMS alarms 1
notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

notes: Two words form one bit field. CLI values reports each nonzero word separately.

project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Verify battery identity before using this separate community map; not queried by CLI.

name: BMS firmware
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: String returned by community mapping.

name: BMS voltage
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Separate battery-side measurement.

name: BMS current
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Separate battery-side measurement.

name: BMS temperature
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Unsigned in community mapping; negative-temperature interpretation not verified.

name: BMS state of charge
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: May differ from inverter SOC.

name: BMS state of health
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Scale differs from inverter register 13024.

name: Maximum-cell position code
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Position decoding not implemented.

name: Minimum-cell position code
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Position decoding not implemented.

name: Module cell maxima, slots 1–8
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Each word is one slot; unused slots may be zero-filled.

name: Module cell minima, slots 1–8
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Each word is one slot; not individual-cell telemetry.

name: Contactor status code
project_use: reference only; not queried by CLI
notes: Kept raw; no universal status decoding claimed.

name: Start/Stop
notes: 207 / 0x00CF Start; 206 / 0x00CE Stop. Only the guarded CLI can send Start.

name: EMS selection
notes: P11: 0 self-consumption; 2 forced; 3 external EMS; 4 VPP. Firmware-dependent.

name: Battery command
notes: 0xAA charge; 0xBB discharge; 0xCC idle command. Context depends on EMS mode.

name: Requested battery power
notes: This is a command setting, not measured battery power.

name: Maximum SOC setting
notes: A configured bound, not actual SOC.

name: Minimum SOC setting
notes: A configured bound, not actual SOC.

name: Feed-in limit value
notes: P11 encoding; check enable state, firmware and applicable model.

name: Feed-in limit enable
notes: 0xAA enabled; 0x55 disabled. Not an installation recommendation.

name: Feed-in limit ratio
notes: P11 encoding; do not confuse with absolute watts.

name: Active-power limit enable
notes: 0xAA enabled; 0x55 disabled. Separate from feed-in limiting.

name: Active-power limit ratio
notes: P11 encoding; different control from grid export limit.
